fields.name: isBook
fields.description: Explicit flag driving portrait reuse/persist-vs-delete behavior in scene image generation. Replaces inferring book-vs-fallback intent from scene group path text.

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: The book's COMMON image config (style + composition + generation params). One config drives portraits, landscape, and scene; style comes from getSDConfigPrompt(sdConfig).

fields.name: compositeSdConfig
fields.description: Optional ALTERNATE config for the composite/Kontext step only (a different pipeline/model). Falls back to sdConfig when absent.

fields.name: sdConfigOverride
fields.description: Optional SPARSE per-scene override (a delta) merged onto the common sdConfig via SDUtil.applyOverrides for this one scene.

fields.name: sceneObjectIds
fields.description: Scene objectIds for POST /{bookObjectId}/prepare-images — batch-resolve landscape prompts before any SD calls.

fields.name: sceneIndex
fields.description: PUT /character/{objectId}/apparel/{apparelObjectId}/scene-tag. UNDECLARED until 2026-08-17, which made it a live KI-24-class defect: RecordDeserializer logs 'Invalid field' and DROPS any property not on this model, so the endpoint's own `sceneIndex == null` guard fired on every real request and scene-tagging always 400'd. Read it with hasField() — an int field returns 0, not null, when absent (KI-25).

fields.name: scenes
fields.description: Scene objectIds in the desired order, for PUT /{bookObjectId}/scenes/order. UNDECLARED until 2026-08-17 — same KI-24-class defect as sceneIndex above: the array was dropped, so every reorder request arrived as an empty list.

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /{bookObjectId}/node/{nodeObjectId}/pin. Defaults true because pinning is the common call; unpinning is the one worth sending explicitly.

fields.name: userNames
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /{bookObjectId}/members — the users to enrol in the book's Writer/Admin role and the organization-wide universe Reader role.

fields.name: asAdmin
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: enrol into the book's Admin tier rather than Writer. Note a book Writer cannot enrol anyone at all — OlioContext.register authorizes on the Admin tier.

fields.name: fromBookObjectId
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /chapter — the source book. Read with AccessPoint.find before anything else, per the KI-67 disposition.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /chapter — the new chapter's book slug. Validated by PbOlioContextUtil.BOOK_SLUG_PATTERN downstream.

fields.name: title
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /chapter — the new chapter's title; falls back to the slug when absent.

fields.name: copyRecordModel
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /chapter — the model of the records being copied into the chapter. Required alongside copyRecordObjectIds, because the destination world group is chosen per model (PbSubRecordUtil.WORLD_GROUP_FIELD).

fields.name: copyRecordObjectIds
fields.description: PB2 phase 4: POST /chapter — records to copy from the source book's world into the new chapter's. §3.5 chose COPY over reference deliberately: apparel/wearables are per character, so a shared instance would make deleting chapter 1 destroy chapter 2's data.

fields.name: poemObjectIds
fields.description: ChapBook creation: objectIds of olio.cb.poem records to include, in order. Undeclared fields are silently dropped by RecordDeserializer (KI-24 pattern) so this must be listed explicitly.

fields.name: maxLinesPerPage
fields.description: ChapBook creation: maximum stanza lines per page. ChapBookUtil defaults to 8 when absent.
